fato_historico: 1920: In the United States, KDKA of Pittsburgh starts broadcasting as the first commercial radio station. The first broadcast is the result of the 1920 United States presidential election.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a broadcast from your own soul, reminiscent of the very first voices carried through the airwaves. It is a good time to adjust your inner dial and listen closely to your intuition. Consider how your unique message reaches the world and embrace the clarity that comes when you finally find your perfect, resonant frequency.
frase_do_dia: Your voice carries the power to tune the world into your beautiful truth.
significado_numero: A master number representing high intuition and spiritual illumination for your path.
conselho: Trust the signals your heart sends today; they are your truest guiding stars.
